dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular closed-loop 'O' and 'C' shaped structures with high-contrast light-intensity perimeters; sharp geometric transitions from darker exterior pixels to a high-intensity light-colored boundary enclosing darker central regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of asymmetrical, high-intensity pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily localized in the posterior-lateral region and along the dorsal margin where ring patterns converge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent mid-lateral macro-annuli form a scalene triangle with the interior angles favoring a longitudinal orientation relative to the body axis.
